audit.comment: Unconditional identity (mu1-mu2)^2/(s1^2+s2^2) = (mu2-mu1)^2/(s2^2+s1^2), proved by ring; corresponds to the per-parameter 1D pull in bao_lib.tension (C_kk = s_Sk^2 + s_Dk^2 since C = C_S + C_D). audit.auditor: workflow automated model referee (round 2), not a person
audit.comment: Sum of two PD symmetric 2x2 matrices in Sylvester form is PD: aS + aD > 0 and (aS+aD)(cS+cD) - (bS+bD)^2 > 0, via aS aD (aS cD + aD cS - 2 bS bD) = aS^2 det_D + aD^2 det_S + (aS bD - aD bS)^2. Correct; justifies that np.linalg.solve's matrix is invertible whenever both posterior covariances are PD (the emcee covariances in fit.json are PD: corr -0.880 and -0.926).

claims.statement: Flat-LCDM BAO-only fit of the real DESI DR2 Gaussian BAO file (13 points, 13x13 cov, sha256-verified): emcee Om = 0.29797 +- 0.00873, hrd = 101.509 +- 0.745 Mpc, corr -0.926; MAP chi2 = 10.27 for 11 dof; an independent 301x301 grid agrees with emcee means within 0.02 sigma.

Flat-LCDM BAO-only fit of the SDSS/eBOSS DR16 BAO compilation with the distributed grid likelihoods (MGS, ELG, Lya auto, Lya x QSO) plus Gaussian DR12/LRG/QSO pieces, never combined with DESI: emcee Om = 0.29873 +- 0.01643, hrd = 100.516 +- 1.285 Mpc, corr -0.880; MAP -2lnL = 11.52 (nominal 12 dof).
The SDSS Gaussian-summary sensitivity variant gives Om = 0.29925 +- 0.01653, hrd = 100.522 +- 1.263 Mpc; shift from the baseline 0.032 sigma (Om) and 0.004 sigma (hrd).

Parameter-difference statistic chi2 = dp^T (C_SDSS + C_DESI)^-1 dp on the emcee moments of B-0001 and B-0002 (surveys treated as independent): chi2 = 1.932, 2 dof, PTE = 0.381, N_sigma = 0.877; cross-checks grid 0.862, MAP+Laplace 0.932, KDE shift 0.939 sigma.
Positive control (200 injected Gaussian realizations at (0.2975, 101.54), seed 20260927) passed: coverage SDSS-GS 0.695/0.675, DESI 0.655/0.665 (window [0.60,0.76]); tension KS PTE-uniform p = 0.549.

All negative controls rejected (all_negative_controls_rejected = True): EdS on DESI Delta(-2lnL) = 1409.9; EdS on the SDSS Gaussian-summary variant Delta = 376.4 (the SDSS-baseline EdS test is non-discriminating, discriminating = False); +inf probe not rejected = True; DM<->DH swap chi2/dof = 5248.7; cov/25 chi2/dof = 23.34; DESI ratios x0.93 give N_sigma = 12.14; combination guard (filename, allow-list, sha256) raised on all three probes = True.

Instrument check passed: input sha256 match the preregistration; three prediction codes agree to 9.3e-15 relative; every grid-likelihood table reproduces its published peak and width; the paired MGS no-rescale negative fails (20.4 sigma off).

CAMB 2.0.4 background cross-check: analytic flat-LCDM DM, H, DV agree with CAMB to < 1e-3 relative at the data redshifts for three test points (max DM 2.0e-4, H 4.8e-4, DV 2.9e-4); CAMB rdrag = 147.1027 Mpc at the Planck-2018 point.
arXiv:2007.08991 Table IV (BAO, flat LCDM) gives Omega_DE = 0.701 +0.017/-0.015, i.e. Om = 0.299 (symmetric sigma 0.016, also quoted by arXiv:2404.03002 Sec. 4.1).
arXiv:2503.14738 eq. (17): DESI DR2 BAO-only flat LCDM Om = 0.2975 +- 0.0086, hrd = (101.54 +- 0.73) Mpc, correlation -0.92.
arXiv:2404.03002 Sec. 4.1 quotes SDSS BAO-only hrd = (100.4 +- 1.3) Mpc, citing arXiv:2007.08991; the value was not found in the fetched pages of 2007.08991 itself (secondary only).
arXiv:2503.14738 states qualitatively that DR2 BAO are consistent with SDSS ('no significant discrepancy'); it publishes no (Om, hrd) tension number.
arXiv:2503.14738 estimates a cross-survey correlation C ~ 0.57 between DESI DR2 LRG2 and eBOSS LRG.
The independent fits reproduce the three primary-verified published values within the preregistered 0.5 sigma: SDSS Om pull -0.017, DESI DR2 Om 0.055, DESI DR2 hrd -0.043 sigma.
The SDSS hrd fit differs from the secondary-sourced 100.4 +- 1.3 Mpc by 0.090 sigma (reported, not counted toward within_tolerance).
The measured N_sigma = 0.877 satisfies the preregistered N_sigma < 2 criterion and so agrees with DESI DR2's qualitative 'consistent with SDSS' statement.

Because the tension statistic treats SDSS and DESI DR2 as independent while their volumes overlap, the reported N_sigma is a lower bound with respect to overlap, provided the cross-survey covariance K satisfies K + K^T positive semidefinite (K itself was not estimated).
The Lean definitions formalise exactly the 2x2 statistic evaluated by scripts/eboss_vs_desi/bao_lib.py::tension (dp = p1-p2, C = c1+c2, chi2 = dp @ solve(C, dp)).
